text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah...!!

Ever since summer training camp started, 
Verxina's intensity had been nothing short 
of terrifying—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!
choice_data_list: Wanna take a break?
Want to take a break?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, whew... No, there is no problem.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Next!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis... I wonder if she'll be okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Since the Oaks ended, I've been a 
little... scared."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. She was always stoic to begin 
with, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, it's kind of... blindly 
flailing around, or something..."
choice_data_list:
So the two of you feel the same way after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's the matter, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Knowing my sister, I don't think she's 
just panicking, but..."
choice_data_list: (What's the best way to put this...)

text_block_list.text:
Watching Gentildonna grow stronger by 
leaps and bounds has undoubtedly made 
Verxina lose confidence and grow anxious.

However, she's working hard to set an 
example for her younger sisters. Admitting 
she has "lost confidence" would go against 
everything she stands for.
choice_data_list: ...Looks like you need a break.
...Looks like you need a break.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!! Leave refreshing yourself to me! Play 
with me and you'll feel better in no time♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I haven't explored around here yet! I 
wanna go all over the place with you, Big 
Sis♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I said refresh... Doing that will just 
make you even more tired, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it nice to take it easy sometimes? 
Like... going fishing, for example.
choice_data_list: Play energetically with Vivlos
Fishing patiently with Cheval.

text_block_list.text:
Thinking that doing something completely 
different might help reset her mind, she 
decided to—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big si~s, over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Wait, Vivlos. Look where you're walking."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer, that we had to cut 
training short."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos made an unreasonable request, 
didn't she?"
choice_data_list: No, I asked for it.
No, I was the one who asked for it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is? ...At such an important time 
like this, why would—
choice_data_list: ...I just wanted you to take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...Excuse me. Thank you, very much."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis! Over here! I found something that 
looks super yummy!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! I'll be right there.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmm~♡ So thweet~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whenever this happens, I always end up 
picking the blue one.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's been like that since way back, hasn't 
it? Hawaiian Blue, and... even with edible 
flowers, you always favored blue.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
'Cause it's super photogenic, and it's 
delicious♡ Are there any other blue sweets 
around?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Wait, let me look it up. You want to take 
a photo together, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's my Big Sis♪ Love you!

"After spending time with her little 
sister, Verxina seemed to regain her usual 
composure, but—"

Perhaps what Verxina needs right now is 
some quiet time to think about nothing. 
With that in mind—

Sitting side-by-side, the three quietly 
cast their fishing lines. Verxina seemed 
eager to get back to training, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Did Cheval tell you? About going 
fishing, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ! No, that's not...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I don't, really, but... Vivlos was 
trying to drag me around...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…………It's not... like I wanted to do that 
or anything.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Even so... Thank you, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………Not really.

Cheval Grand's reply was blunt, but 
Verxina seems somewhat pleased. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Eek! This pull...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer, that net over there, please...!
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.text:
"After spending time with her little 
sister, Verxina seemed to regain her usual 
composure, but—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, shall we resume our 
training?”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wha--?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We were just hanging out for a bit! You've 
been training since morning, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you call it a day then? Spend a 
little more time with us, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: That's not something for us to decide...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! Can we, please? Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I suppose so...
Yeah, that's true...

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, thanks in part to her hard work 
since the training camp began, she's been 
clearing the high goals we set. There 
shouldn't be any problem with letting her 
rest after this, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm not in a position to be making 
half-hearted excuses. The Shuka Sho is 
right around the corner...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I have to work harder. Harder and 
harder... or else—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I can't win.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, please take the two of them out 
for a meal or something."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out for some independent 
training.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! Wait for me~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wait up, I said!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big Sister, that's so mean... So mean!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! Huh—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, okay? It's not like I was 
pushing you away...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Not that! Big sis is... she's being mean 
to her big sis!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Even though you're so strong! You're so 
strong and cool, and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely! —Watch my super-strong, 
super-amazing... big sister!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She's gonna be totally fine, I know it! My 
big sister is...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: ...Cheval, how about you?
...Cheval, how about you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh!? N-No, I'm...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I just... truly don't understand. What it 
is that's... driving my sister.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Gentile is strong. I thought she was 
incredible... but.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...You feel that way too, don't you, big 
sis?"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah, Verxina-san is so fast! 
Cheval-chan's big sister is amazing, isn't 
she?"

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
"...Hehe. Yeah, she's amazing. Big sis 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! It's Verxina-san! She's amazing as 
always...!" "...Wait, isn't she 
Cheval-san's older sister?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yeah. That's right, my sister... is 
amazing."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—...More amazing than anyone. That is... 
my big sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval...

"Hearing the respect in her sisters' 
words, I can feel Verxina's heart slowly 
unwind. What those feelings convey is..."
choice_data_list: To them, you're the strongest.
To them, you're the strongest, you know.

text_block_list.text:
Verxina asked to talk in private, so after 
reassuring her still-worried younger 
sisters, we headed to the beach—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You were losing confidence in yourself 
again, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I want to reach the top, so I can be an 
older sister she can be proud of. Thinking 
that, every single day—
choice_data_list:
You've worked so hard for this... without 
a doubt.

You really have worked hard... without a 
doubt.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. And yet... I panicked more than I 
needed to.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...That sheer strength of Ms. 
Gentildonna's. I just... can't help but 
find it terrifying."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Ever since then... I've been 
terrified of her."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
So, trying to shake it off... I ran and 
ran with all my might—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...And before I knew it, I had ended up... 
somewhere completely off-track.
choice_data_list: Don't try to fight all on your own.
Don't try to fight all on your own.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list:
You have your little sisters... and you 
have me.

You have your little sisters... and me, 
too.

text_block_list.text:
As I said that, I handed her the tablet, 
which displayed a final training routine 
with a higher workload, carefully tuned 
within a manageable range.
choice_data_list:
I was making adjustments while watching 
how hard you were working.

I was making revisions while watching how 
hard you worked

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...This is an immense amount of training, 
isn't it...? If I can get through all of 
this, I feel like I can grow even more."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Will I be able to do it? Can someone 
like me—
choice_data_list: What if it's "for your little sisters"?
What if it's "for your little sisters"?

text_block_list.text:
Verxina's expression instantly tightened. 
Replacing all doubt with regal poise, what 
dwelled within her eyes was—

âA definite, unmistakable fighting 
spirit.
choice_data_list: ...That's it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list:
Your fighting spirit to race for others is 
your greatest weapon.

Your fighting spirit to race for others is 
your greatest weapon.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: My... weapon...
choice_data_list:
As long as that flame burns, you can 
become stronger!

As long as that flame burns, you can 
become stronger!

text_block_list.text:
The training regimen I've laid out for her 
is grueling, but... I'm certain that if 
she can see it through, it will lead to 
remarkable growth.
choice_data_list: I believe in your weapons. How about you?
I believe in your weapon. Do you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, I believe. In your training 
menu... and in you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You have certainly reminded me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That I truly am an Umamusume deserving of 
the apex... and worthy of my younger 
sisters' respect.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of my sisters... and for 
you, as well. —I swear I will win the 
Shuka Sho!"
